data.title: STOCKS | AgBank, ICBC Target Private Placements Worth Up to $38.7 Billion
data.description:
Agricultural Bank of China Ltd. plans to raise up to 160 billion yuan ($23.8 billion) and Industrial & Commercial Bank of China Ltd. is targeting 100 billion yuan in separate A-share private placements, according to Bloomberg.

The filings were made with the Shanghai Stock Exchange.

data.title: Bitcoin Short-Term Holder Profitability Turns Positive for First Time in Over a Year
data.description: CryptoQuant analyst Darkfost said on X that Bitcoin's short-term holder spent output profit ratio, or STH SOPR, has shown a notable recent change. According to ChainCatcher, the metric, which measures realized profits for holders with a holding period of less than six months, has risen above 1 to about 1.01, marking its first move into profitable territory in more than a year.

data.title: Solana Says August Transaction Volume Reached 5 Billion as Alpenglow Upgrade Nears
data.description: Solana said on X that it processed 5 billion transactions in August, more than all other blockchain networks combined, while keeping transaction fees far below those of other public chains. According to Odaily, the network handled more than 100,000 transactions per minute, and the Alpenglow upgrade, designed to speed up confirmations, is expected to launch in October and cut transaction confirmation time from about 12 seconds to 400 milliseconds.

data.title: GEOPOLITICS | Russia, Ukraine Trade Strikes as Kushner, Witkoff Head to Kyiv
data.description:
Russia and Ukraine exchanged another wave of overnight strikes as US envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff were set to travel to Kyiv from Moscow after talks with President Vladimir Putin, according to Bloomberg.

The trip follows their meeting with Putin in Moscow.

data.title: Turkey's Vice President Yilmaz Expects 2.1 Million New Jobs by End-2029
data.description: According to Jin10, Turkey's Vice President Yilmaz said the country expects to add 2.1 million jobs by the end of 2029 and cut the unemployment rate to below 8%.

data.title: AI TRENDS | Animoca Brands' Minds and AWS Launch Agent Virtual Soccer League
data.description:
Animoca Brands' AI agent platform Minds has partnered with AWS to launch an agent virtual soccer league, with registration now open for the first Alpha season. According to Foresight News, the competition will begin on September 11, 2026.

The Alpha season will include up to six leagues, with each league able to accommodate up to 2,000 teams. Each team will play 10 matches on Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays. Up to six league champions and four wildcard winners will advance to the final.

Finalists will receive travel support, including airfare and accommodation, a $500 prize, and admission to AWS re:Invent. Participants will be invited to build and guide an AI team for five-a-side soccer using natural language instructions. Each participant will also receive an assistant coach to help develop team tactics and strategy throughout the competition.

data.title: Whale Loracle Announces Fable 5.1 AI-Based Fork of Pons Token Issuance Platform
data.description: Whale Loracle announced on X that they used the Fable 5.1 AI model to create a fork of the Pons token issuance platform called pez[.]family. According to Odaily, the platform charges a 0% fee.

data.title: Humain Plans $2.5 Billion Fund for Data Center Investments
data.description:
Artificial intelligence company Humain is planning to raise its first $2.5 billion to establish a fund focused on data center investments. According to ChainCatcher, people familiar with the matter said the fund would help finance 250 megawatts of data center capacity being built by Humain in partnership with Al Moammar Information Systems, with the total scale potentially expanding to 1 gigawatt.

Humain is backed by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund and is advancing local AI computing power and data center infrastructure to meet rising demand for AI computing.

data.title: Aishida Says Embodied AI Robot Project Remains Early Stage After 2-Day Share Surge
data.description:
Aishida said its shares had an abnormal trading move after the stock's closing price deviated by more than 20% over two consecutive trading days on September 3 and September 4, 2026. Jiemian News reported that the company said its main businesses are cookware, small appliances and industrial robots. As of June 30, 2026, Aishida reported revenue of 1.351 billion yuan and a net loss attributable to parent shareholders of 93.4142 million yuan. Cookware and small appliances accounted for 84.46% of revenue, while industrial robots made up 12.20%.

The company said its embodied AI robot cooperation project is a newly developed business that is still at an early stage, with sales revenue of only 137,200 yuan so far. It added that the project faces uncertainties in technology iteration, implementation and commercialization, and is expected to have no material impact on the company's financial position or operating results this year.

data.title: Turkey's Vice President Yilmaz Says War's Inflation Impact Is Estimated at About 7 Percentage Points
data.description: According to Jin10, Turkey's Vice President Yilmaz said the direct and indirect impact of war on inflation is estimated at about 7 percentage points.

data.title: Turkey's Vice President Yilmaz Says Main Goal Is to Reduce Inflation to Single Digits
data.description: According to Jin10, Turkey's Vice President Yilmaz said the main goal is to reduce inflation to single digits to ensure lasting price stability and maintain fiscal discipline.

data.title: Turkey's Vice President Yilmaz Raises 2026 Growth Forecast to 3.3%, Inflation Forecast to 28.4%
data.description: According to Jin10, Turkey's Vice President Yilmaz said the country's 2026 economic growth forecast has been raised to 3.3% and its 2026 inflation forecast has been updated to 28.4%.

data.title: Turkey's Vice President Yilmaz Says Changes in Economic and Inflation Forecasts Do Not Alter Policy Direction
data.description: According to Jin10, Turkey's Vice President Yilmaz said changes in economic and inflation forecasts do not mean there has been any change in the direction or main framework of the government's plan.

data.title: George Russell's 2026 F1 Italian Grand Prix Win Probability Rises to 49% on Polymarket
data.description:
Polymarket odds for George Russell to win the 2026 F1 Italian Grand Prix rose to 49%, up 13 percentage points over the past 24 hours. According to Odaily, Pierre Gasly's win probability also climbed from 0% to 6%.

The 2026 F1 Italian Grand Prix is scheduled to start at 21:00 (UTC+8) tonight at Monza. Qualifying produced several surprises, with Gasly taking his first career pole in 1:21.786, Russell finishing second, and Oscar Piastri dropping three places after being penalized for impeding another driver. Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton moved up to third and fourth on the grid, respectively.

data.title: JD.com Insurance Advisory Opens Offline Service Center in Hong Kong
data.description:
JD Insurance Advisory (Hong Kong) has formally set up an offline service center in Hong Kong, located on the 16th floor of One Peking, a building known for housing many insurers, according to Ming Pao.

The move comes after Ming Pao reported last October that JD.com (9618) had entered Hong Kong's insurance brokerage business, although no major developments had been seen until now.

data.title: U.S. Drafts Postwar Iran Containment Strategy for the Middle East
data.description:
The U.S. government is drafting a postwar strategy to contain Iran, with a focus on rallying Middle Eastern countries and advancing normalization between those states and U.S. ally Israel, according to Jiemian News. Two U.S. officials and two other people familiar with the matter said the plan is still in an early stage and may take several more weeks to complete.

The draft is said to have three main elements: building a regional front to contain Iran with the U.S. acting as a guarantor; pushing ahead with the second phase of the so-called Gaza peace plan to help Israel reach security arrangements with Syria and implement a ceasefire framework with Lebanon; and expanding the Abraham Accords to bring Israel into relations with more Arab states, especially Saudi Arabia. The plan is intended to guide U.S. Middle East policy in the final two years of President Donald Trump's term after the war ends.

The report said the plan could be affected by Israel's October 27 election and the U.S. congressional midterm elections in November. It also noted that Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has publicly rejected the Gaza peace plan, while Israeli forces continue strikes in Lebanon and Syria and have refused to fully withdraw from those countries.

data.title: Bitcoin Miner Holdings Rise for First Time in Two Weeks as Hashrate Climbs
data.description: As of 2:00 p.m. on September 5, Bitcoin miner holdings stood at about 1.1919 million BTC, up 261 BTC from a week earlier. According to Odaily, this was the first weekly increase of that size in about two weeks, since August 26. Over the same period, Bitcoin's seven-day average hashrate rose to about 934 million TH/s, up roughly 41.11 million TH/s from a week earlier. Bitcoin's Puell Multiple also increased to 1.00, up 0.04 from the previous week.

data.title: Polymarket Bitcoin September 6 Breakout Bet Sees Sharp Drop in 80,000 Yes Odds
data.description: Catcher Predict monitoring showed that the Polymarket submarket "80,000" in the "Bitcoin breaks through on September 6" event saw its "Yes" odds swing sharply. According to ChainCatcher, the probability fell from 46.5% one hour earlier to 26.5% at present, a 20% move. The article said related breaking news may have affected the market.

data.title: GEOPOLITICS | Hong Kong Sees More Central Asian State Firms Heading for Listings
data.description:
Hong Kong Financial Secretary Paul Chan said more Central Asian state-owned infrastructure companies are planning to list in the city, according to Bloomberg.

Chan said Hong Kong is seeking to diversify markets and strengthen ties with the fast-growing region.
